versions.changelog:
Initial public release with expanded references, script assets, and a streamlined workflow.

- Added comprehensive references and sample prompts for typical project types.
- Introduced multiple scripts for deck building, image export, and asset automation.
- Updated documentation to emphasize content-driven, user-confirmed design with native editable PPTX output.
- Enforced workflow approvals at structure, storyboard, and visual prototype stages.
- Removed legacy skill-card and migrated all process notes into structured files.

custom-ai-pptx-generator 1.0.1

- Removed the sample file: skill-card.md
- No changes to workflow or user experience; functionality remains unchanged.

custom-ai-pptx-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of the 千题千境 (QianTi QianJing) AI-PPT baseline workflow.
- Provides end-to-end, stepwise generation of fully editable PowerPoint presentations from user-supplied requirements and materials, including 3 required user confirmation stages.
- Follows a strict 5-step workflow: content analysis → design intent brief → structure confirmation → ASCII storyboard → visual prototype → native pptx rebuild → visual QA.
- Ensures only PowerPoint-native editable objects (no image-slab slides); directs user involvement on style, color, and content at key checkpoints.
- Supports custom requests in Chinese and English; tested and validated on "policy/process explainer" and "employee journey" scenarios.
- Adheres to hard collaboration and deliverable rules, including versioned files, explicit design intent, and visual/wording difference reporting at delivery.
